verdicts.reason: A stacks everything under the watch: the CTA almost touches the legal block, which leaves a cramped bottom under an empty top. The logo is shrunk to a tiny mark wedged beside the fine print instead of leading the layout as it did in the original. The headline also runs almost edge to edge, and the price now sits above the description. B has the same flaws with the tiny bottom-left logo, the nearly full-bleed headline and the swapped price and description order, plus a slightly tight top margin. Its headline → product → CTA order spreads the weight more evenly, so the space looks more deliberate.
